_comment: Greater fire elemental, ELITE tier (2026-07-21): the fire line's apex, curveLevel 20 = Orc-equivalent, the hardest non-boss content alongside the front. Elite baseline ≈4x its normal counterpart (Orc 280 / EliteBandit 240 precedent). Carries the SAME FireElementalAura as the small one by PO ruling — the extra HP and damage come from the elite baseline + f(cL20), not a separate skill. Slower still (0.45): it is a walking furnace, kiting is the counterplay. Drops FireTotem @0.2 — the signature-drop rate (LongRangeStrike/Reaper precedent). PO places spawns in the editor. All values [PLACEHOLDER] ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2d (D4): partial resistances. Before this pass resistances existed ONLY as lock-and-key gates ({"*": 0, "harvest": 1}) — never as mitigation — so every hit in the game landed for full and a damage type meant nothing. These are the curated set that gives the type axis teeth: made of it, and undone by its opposite. Deliberately NON-physical — the C8 tier-threshold guardrail drives its bot with authored Damage at L1, which is physical, so a physical entry here would silently move a calibration this pass has no business moving. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
